programme.title: The Big Ugly
programme.desc: Les relations anglo-américaines se détériorent quand des mafieux londoniens investissent en Virginie.

programme.title: Serieously Ep.19
programme.desc: Ton rendez-vous francophone préféré sur les séries, le cinéma et la pop culture en général!

programme.title: Écran Large Ep.1
programme.desc: Écran Large : actu ciné, séries, comics, jeux vidéo

programme.title: Écran Large Ep.5
programme.desc: Écran Large : actu ciné, séries, comics, jeux vidéo

programme.title: Écran Large Ep.6
programme.desc: Écran Large : actu ciné, séries, comics, jeux vidéo

programme.title: Le Duel
programme.desc: Un Texas Ranger enquête sur une série de décès inexpliqués dans une ville appelée Helena.

programme.title: The Big Ugly
programme.desc: Les relations anglo-américaines se détériorent quand des mafieux londoniens investissent en Virginie.

programme.title: The Best Offer
programme.desc: Virgil Oldman, un expert en art reclus, acquiert des tableaux inestimables en trompant leurs propriétaires sur leur valeur. Engagé par la mystérieuse Claire Ibbetson pour évaluer son patrimoine, Virgil découvre des pièces mécaniques et demande l'aide de son ami Robert pour les réassembler.

programme.title: Love, Romance & Chocolate
programme.desc: Emma et le chocolatier Luc concourent pour le titre de Chocolatier Rayal de Belgique. La beauté et le romantisme de Bruges inspirent des combinaisons de chocolats uniques, mais gagneront-t-ils sans qu'ils y perdent leur cœur ?

programme.title: Supernova
programme.desc: Sam et Tusker s'aiment depuis 20 ans. À bord de leur vieux camping-car, ils rendent visite à leurs amis et famille et retournent sur les lieux de leur jeunesse.

programme.title: One Last Dance
programme.desc: À la suite d'une tragédie, une compagnie de danse renommée de New York est au bord de l'effondrement. Après avoir quitté le monde de la danse pour de bon, Travis, Chrissa et Max ont une dernière chance de renouer avec leur passion et de prouver que les miracles peuvent toujours arriver.

programme.title: Fandango
programme.desc: A 12 ans, Claire se prend d'affection pour un pur-sang, nommé Fandango. La jeune fille découvre alors que l'animal est traumatisé par l'accident de son cavalier, l'ancien champion Cal Masterson. Avec l'aide de Cal, elle fera tout pour aider son cheval à surmonter ses peurs.

programme.title: Coup de foudre à Mumbai
programme.desc: Après le crash de son avion, Sarah a été recueillie par les habitants d'un village près de Mumbai. La jeune femme devient le guide de Max, un routier engagé par Oskar, dont elle a pour mission de le conduire à son village. Mais les choses se compliquent lorsque Sarah découvre qu'Oskar veut chasser les villageois pour monter un projet en vue des Jeux Olympiques.

programme.title: Une Bonne Femme
programme.desc: Une jeune mère récemment veuve est prête à tout pour protéger ses enfants alors qu'elle cherche la vérité sur le meurtre de son mari.

programme.title: La Chanteuse Amoureuse
programme.desc: Une pop star frustrée par la gestion excessive de sa carrière, rêvant d'une vie ordinaire, se retrouve partagée entre son ex célèbre, les manigances de son manager autoritaire et une romance naissante avec un propriétaire de disquaire terre-à-terre.

programme.title: Lethal Justice
programme.desc: Les policiers locaux de la ville d'Edmond ont leur propre méthode pour lutter contre les criminels: ils s'assurent que justice soit faite sur les lieux même du crime.

programme.title: Oxygen
programme.desc: Deux gars kidnappent la femme d'un homme riche et l'enterrent dans une boîte avec 24 heures d'oxygène. La détective coriace du NYPD Maddy et d'autres obtiennent l'affaire. L'atteindront-ils à temps ?

programme.title: Macbeth
programme.desc: Les bas-fonds de Melbourne, dans un futur proche. Macbeth est le bras droit de Duncan, le parrain local. Selon une prophétie, Duncan, deviendra prochainement un gangster extrêmement puissant, sans rival ni limite. Dévorée d'ambition, la femme de Macbeth tente de le convaincre de tuer Duncan afin de prendre sa place.

programme.title: Kill me Later
programme.desc: Shawn Holloway mène une vie misérable depuis ses onze ans, lorsque son père quitte sa mère et la laisse seule avec une mère problématique.

programme.title: Ricky Bobby: Roi Du Circuit
programme.desc: Il court, il court, le Ricky Bobby. Ricky Bobby du Nascar ici. Ricky Bobby du Nascar par là. Toujours plus vite il va. Sur les podiums victorieux il s'asseoit. Mais tant va le succès qu'à la fin, Ricky Bobby n'est plus ni diva ni divin. Et contre ses démons se bat. Pour retrouver ses vroums vroums d'émois...

programme.title: Garde Rapprochee
programme.desc: Sharp, un Texas Ranger habitué des dossiers sensibles, doit protéger les seuls témoins du meurtre de son indic : cinq pom-pom girls, incontrôlables et survoltées ! Il pensait avoir tout vu. Il va vite déchanter.

programme.title: Espion Et Demi
programme.desc: Un boxeur professionnel doit aider un agent du gouvernement américain à retrouver un avion espion disparu avant qu'il ne tombe entre les mains de terroristes.

programme.title: Self Control
programme.desc: Dave Buznik est un homme calme et doux qui n'aime pas les situations conflictuelles jusqu'au jour où, à la suite d'une altercation dans un avion, et malgré lui, il se trouve dans l'obligation de suivre une thérapie supposée contrôler sa colère.

programme.title: L'Attaque des fourmis géantes
programme.desc: Un groupe de rock has been veut tenter un comeback au festival de rock Coachella, dans le désert californien.Mais, à la nuit tombée, leur manque de respect pour la nature va se retourner contre eux et en faire la cible d'insectes surdimensionnés et affamés.

programme.title: Super Héros Movie
programme.desc: Un adolescent orphelin est mordu par une libellule radioactive, ce qui lui confère des pouvoirs surhumains dans cette parodie de films tels que "Spider-Man", "X-Men" et "Fantastic Four".

programme.title: Bill et Ted sauvent l'univers
programme.desc: Les enjeux n'ont jamais été aussi grands pour Bill et Ted qui, toujours désireux de réaliser leur destin rock and roll, s'embarquent dans une nouvelle aventure lorsqu'un visiteur les prévient que seule leur chanson peut sauver la vie tell.

programme.title: Sissy
programme.desc: Cecilia et Emma, meilleures amies pendant leur adolescence, se croisent après une décennie. Cecilia est invitée au week-end d'enterrement de vie de jeune fille d'Emma, où elle se retrouve coincée dans une cabane avec son bully du lycée. Elle a un goût pour la vengeance.

programme.title: Les Chaises Musicales
programme.desc: Par accident, elle fait tomber un homme dans la benne d'une déchèterie. L'inconnu est dans le coma, mais Perrine est prête à tout pour qu'il se réveille.Perrine est une musicienne presque professionnelle. Elle vit seule et anime des goûters d'anniversaires, ou les gâche, c'est selon.

programme.title: Une minute pour prier, une seconde pour mourir
programme.desc: L'apparition de Clay McCord déclenche une violente confrontation entre le marshal local, McCord et d'autres hors-la-loi.

programme.title: Jack l'Éclair
programme.desc: Lightning Jack Kane est un hors-la-loi australien dans l'Ouest sauvage.

programme.title: Django et Sartana
programme.desc: La petite ville désertique de Black City est plongée dans la terreur par une bande de criminels dirigée par l'impitoyable Bud Willer.

programme.title: Des dollars plein la gueule
programme.desc: Un chasseur de primes nommé Amen est engagé par un groupe de nonnes pour récupérer de l'argent volé.

programme.title: Bandidos
programme.desc: Le célèbre tireur Richard Martin voyage à bord d'un train, retenu par Billy Kane, un ancien élève de Martin.

programme.title: Custer, l'homme de l'Ouest
programme.desc: L'amour de George Armstrong Custer pour les traditions héroïques du calvaire et son dégoût pour l'arrivée de l'industrialisation le conduisent à son destin à Little Big Horn.

programme.title: La mort était au rendez-vous
programme.desc: Un jeune tireur forme une alliance ténue avec un ancien hors-la-loi vieillissant pour traquer et éliminer les bandits qui ont tué sa famille, jusqu'à la fin surprenante.

programme.title: Le Géant de Métropolis
programme.desc: Muscleman Ohro se rend dans la capitale pécheresse de l'Atlantide pour réprimander son impiété et son orgueil, et s'engage dans la bataille contre son seigneur maléfique Yoh-tar et ses plans hideux de super-science.

programme.title: Le Rocher du Diable
programme.desc: Deux vieux amis se retrouvent dans des camps opposés pendant la guerre civile lors d'une bataille désespérée au sommet d'une montagne imprenable.

programme.title: Les amours de Salomé
programme.desc: Une célèbre ballerine viennoise fuit l'Europe pendant la guerre austro-prussienne et tombe amoureuse d'un bandit américain qui ressemble à son défunt amant royal.

programme.title: Amigo!... Mon colt a deux mots à te dire
programme.desc: Un vagabond aux poings rapides et un proxénète armé de pistolets rapides aident un enfant à réclamer son héritage.

programme.title: Seisme Imminent
programme.desc: Un pirate informatique mécontent utilise le fils rebelle du président d'une grande société de logiciels pour créer Havoc.

programme.title: La Main De La Justice
programme.desc: "Quand on confie à Eva l'enquête du meurtre d'une strip-teaseuse, sa vie telle qu'elle la connaît va changer du tout au tout. Magistrat à seulement 35 ans, elle a passé sa vie à étudier et vit entièrement pour son travail, pour lutter contre la corruption. Mais quand un gigolo particulièrement séduisant, Rocco, le petit-ami de la victime, lui propose d'être son témoin principal, sa carrière prend un virage dangereux. Eva, qui garde toujours le contrôle, déportera ses instincts obsessifs sur le jeune homme, qui l'entraînera dans un jeu de possession et manipulation dont elle ne sortira pas indemne."

programme.title: Terror Experiment
programme.desc: Un terroriste déclenche une explosion qui fait basculer le bâtiment fédéral et libère un gaz toxique dans tout le système de ventilation. Son but : exposer l'arme de guerre biologique secrète du gouvernement, un virus mortel qui attaque instantanément le système surrénalien d'une personne, la poussant à devenir inhumainement agressive, avec une envie incontrôlable de s'entretuer.

programme.title: BIT
programme.desc: Une adolescente transgenre en vacances d'été à Los Angeles se bat pour survivre après être tombée sur quatre vampires féministes queer, qui tentent de débarrasser les rues de la ville des hommes prédateurs.

programme.title: Final Draft
programme.desc: Un scénariste en herbe qui tente d'écrire un nouveau scénario d'horreur sombre mentalement après plusieurs jours d'isolement dans son appartement.

programme.title: Alien Invasion : L'Éveil du Phénix
programme.desc: Une pluie d'astéroïdes frappe une station spatiale, puis atterrit dans une zone reculée du Grand Canyon. Des capsules mystérieuses se forment et mutent rapidement en créatures menaçant la station spatiale et la Terre.

programme.title: Ape vs Monster
programme.desc: Une capsule spatiale renfermant un chimpanzé revient sur Terre. Elle contient également une substance inconnue qui permet au singe, ainsi qu'à un lézard, d'atteindre des tailles gigantesques, entraînant une lutte entre eux sans merci pour la domination du monde.

programme.title: Time Run
programme.desc: Sergey, champion d'athlétisme brisé par un accident, découvre que ses blessures lui permettent de voir le passé quand son cœur s'emballe. Pendant ce temps, l'inspectrice Nastya traque un tueur de femmes dans la ville.

programme.title: Curvature
programme.desc: Après le suicide de son mari Wells, Helen découvre que son passé cachait bien des secrets. Lors d'une étrange panne de courant, elle se réveille chez elle et reçoit un appel d'elle-même l'avertissant qu'un homme vient pour la tuer.

programme.title: Astral

programme.desc: Tom vit avec son père dans un conteneur, dans la pauvreté et le bonheur. Mais tout change lorsqu'un travailleur social de la protection de l'enfance intervient.

programme.desc: James et ses amis proches poursuivent un voyage malavisé le long des côtes du Pays-de-Galles. Dans cette aventure touchante et comique, l'amitié, l'héroïsme et l'amour vont se côtoyer.

programme.title: L'Oracle
programme.desc: Dans la Perse du XIe siècle, un apprenti chirurgien se déguise en Juif pour étudier dans une école qui n'admet pas de chrétiens.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Un rite d'initiation d'une fraternité universitaire tourne mal. Un étudiant blessé par balle et une employée de supérette kidnappée se retrouvent au foyer de la fraternité. La panique persiste.

programme.title: The river king
programme.desc: Un jeune inspecteur de police d'une petite ville doit enquêter sur la noyade d'un étudiant. Le directeur de l'école étouffe le scandale en présentant ceci comme un suicide.

programme.title: The Other Me
programme.desc: Un architecte est atteint d'une maladie oculaire qui l'introduit dans une réalité surréaliste dans laquelle il voit les motivations des gens. Les visions devenant intolérables, il tombe amoureux d'une femme mystérieuse.

programme.title: The Loft
programme.desc: Cinq hommes mariés se partagent secrètement un loft à New York pour assouvir tous leurs fantasmes. Mais la combine tourne au cauchemar quand ils découvrent le cadavre d'une femme inconnue.

programme.title: In Search of Darkness
programme.desc: Plongez dans l'horreur des années 80 avec cette conclusion gargantuesque qui s'attaque à l'âge d'or de la VHS et des vidéoclubs, dresse les portraits d'artistes et artisans incontournables et aborde de nombreuses pépites oubliées d'un cinéma imaginatif, sanglant, expérimental, indispensable…

programme.title: Vigilante
programme.desc: Fou de rage après l'agression de son épouse et le meurtre de son fils et écœuré par le laxisme et la corruption des autorités, qui ont permis aux responsables d'être libérés, un électricien new-yorkais s'acoquine avec un groupe d'auto-défense, dans lequel il refusait d'entrer jusqu'alors, afin de venger sa famille.

programme.title: Malum
programme.desc: Une jeune policière tente de percer le lien mystérieux entre la mort de son père et l'arrestation d'une secte. Pour ce faire, elle accepte de prendre poste dans le commissariat où son père a trouvé la mort. Bientôt, elle est victime d'événements surnaturels terrifiants...

programme.title: The Belgian Wave
programme.desc: Au début des années 90, le journaliste Marc Varenberg et son caméraman disparaissent dans des circonstances mystérieuses alors qu'ils enquêtent sur la Vague Belge (une série d'observations d'Ovni survenus entre 1989 et 1991). Près de 30 ans plus tard, deux webreporters rouvrent l'enquête pour découvrir ce qui s'est réellement passé.

programme.title: In Search of Darkness
programme.desc: Plongez dans l'horreur des années 80 avec cette conclusion gargantuesque qui s'attaque à l'âge d'or de la VHS et des vidéoclubs, dresse les portraits d'artistes et artisans incontournables et aborde de nombreuses pépites oubliées d'un cinéma imaginatif, sanglant, expérimental, indispensable…

programme.desc: En pleine pandémie mondiale, un vortex menace de recouvrir la Terre de glace

programme.title: Doomsday Meteor
programme.desc: Un météore géant menace la Terre : une mission spatiale est envoyée pour le détourner, mais tout tourne mal.

programme.title: Fire Island, la grande éruption
programme.desc: À Hawaï, un supervolcan entre en éruption, forçant une équipe à secourir les habitants menacés.

programme.title: Bullet Proof
programme.desc: Après avoir volé des millions à un mafieux, un voleur découvre à bord sa compagne enceinte.

programme.title: La ligne de feu
programme.desc: L'histoire de la résistance héroïque des cadets de Podolsk aux abords de Moscou en octobre 1941.

programme.title: Badland
programme.desc: Le détective Matthias Breecher est engagé pour traquer les pires criminels de guerre confédérés.
Un père de famille en difficulté découvre un salon caché qui offre une solution…les sexbots.

programme.title: Asher
programme.desc: Ancien agent du Mossad, Asher est désormais mercenaire professionnel. Proche de prendre sa retraite, il rencontre Sophie et va tenter avec elle de mener une vie normale avant qu'il ne soit trop tard.

programme.title: Sheena Reine De La Jungle
programme.desc: Orpheline, la blonde Sheena est recueillie par une tribu qui lui apprend à communiquer par télépathie avec les animaux. Un journaliste télé à l'esprit caustique, Vic Casey, lui donne une leçon en amour personnelle. En Afrique pour un reportage sur un joueur de football de sang royal, le Prince Otwani, Vic se trouve rapidement mêlé à un nid d'intrigues politiques.

programme.title: Memoire Effacee
programme.desc: Hantée par la mort de son fils, Telly s'entend affirmer par un psychiatre que l'enfant n'a jamais existé, et qu'elle est victime d'hallucinations. Et elle ne retrouve effectivement aucune trace du disparu... En compagne d'Ash, qui a aussi perdu son enfant dans le même crash aérien, Telly va tenter de faire éclater la vérité

programme.title: Takers
programme.desc: TAKERS raconte l'histoire d'un célèbre groupe de braqueurs qui continuent à désarçonner la police en commettant des braquages de banques parfaits. Tout marche comme sur des roulettes : ils ne laissent jamais aucune preuve derrière eux et font profil bas entre chaque hold-up.

programme.title: Money Monster
programme.desc: Lee Gates, un présentateur TV spécialiste de la bourse, est réputé pour faire la pluie et le beau temps à Wall Street. Ses conseils vont pourtant finir par le placer dans une situation périlleuse, le jour où un jeune homme, qui s'est ruiné à cause d'un dangereux placement boursier, décide de prendre cette célébrité en otage... en direct à la télévision.

programme.title: May
programme.desc: Pour May, ses divers connaissances semblent toutes avoir quelques caractéristiques parfaites, mais aucune n'est entièrement parfaite. Cela mène cette jeune femme créative et folle à créer à sa propre façon l'ami parfait, morceau par morceau.

programme.title: Pour toujours et a jamais
programme.desc: Après qu'une tragédie réunit Nicole avec ses amis d'enfance, ils se retrouvent chacun en danger, ciblés par un harceleur fou. Nicole sait que ça ne peut pas être une coïncidence. Les secrets de leur passé reviennent les hanter.

programme.title: La promesse d'Irena
programme.desc: Varsovie, 1939. Lorsque les nazis envahissent la Pologne, l'infirmière Irena Gut est déportée et contrainte de travailler pour soutenir l'effort de guerre allemand.

programme.title: Lamborghini : L'homme derrière la légende
programme.desc: Adapté du livre de son fils Tonino, le film retrace la vie de Ferruccio Lamborghini, le célèbre créateur de la marque automobile éponyme.

programme.title: Hierarchy : Braquage au sommet
programme.desc: Deux frères adoptifs s'apprêtent à réaliser le braquage le plus risqué de leur vie, un coup qui pourrait les libérer à jamais. Mais traqués par une mafia impitoyable et une police prête à tout pour les arrêter, ils devront choisir entre la fuite, la loyauté… ou la survie.

programme.title: Wolfblood S01 E03
programme.desc: It's the school art exhibition and the theme is family. Rhydian puts up a picture of a lonely boy, with silhouettes of parents in the distant background. He storms out when the 3 Ks comment on it. Tom has put up loads of pictures of him and his dad at football matches, he is excited that his dad is coming to the exhibition.

programme.title: Wolfblood S01 E04
programme.desc: Maddy's got her exams coming up, but she isn't feeling very well and is grouchy - her first change is coming... Tom reminds her she forgot to help him with his English revision for the exam tomorrow and she promises to make it up to him at break but at break she is struggling pre-change and Rhydian takes her for a run to blow off steam.

programme.title: Wolfblood S01 E05
programme.desc: It's full moon tonight and Maddy is anxious about her first transformation, but also bursting with the energy that a full moon brings. The school are on a day trip to the historic isle of Lindisfarne, but Maddy and Rhydian are feeling cramped in the ancient stoney ruins and are not looking forward to spending the night in the den...

programme.title: Wolfblood S01 E06
programme.desc: The wolf energy is still strong in Maddy's blood, she gets carried away in assembly watching the street dance club and joins in with their routine. She is fantastic, (which puts Kay's nose right out of joint!). Everyone now thinks Maddy is cool, especially Dean Samuels, the cutest boy in school!

programme.title: Wolfblood S01 E07
programme.desc: When there is no moon, wolfbloods become lethargic and are stripped of their powers. Tomorrow is no moon and Maddy and Rhyidian aren't looking forward to it! Stuck in detention, mischievous Maddy decides to have some fun and gets Rhydian to join in. Whilst Mr Jeffries slips out they take the school trophy and hide it on the school roof - Maddy accidentally cuts herself whilst doing this.

programme.title: Wolfblood S01 E08
programme.desc: Animals have been going missing around the village and Shannon thinks that the beast is back. Instead of having their movie night, she wants them to all go beast hunting. At first Maddy isn't keen to go, wanting a wolf free night, but when Shannon tells Maddy that her mum is sending her to a psychiatrist because of her beast fixation, Maddy agrees to go.

programme.title: Wolfblood S01 E09
programme.desc: It's the night before full moon and Rhydian is spending a practice night in the Smith's den. The next day on their way to school Maddy and Rhydian sniff out some stolen goods -Sinclair gear hidden in the woods! They take a few t-shirts for themselves, Tom and Shannon. Shannon doesn't want a t-shirt as they aren't ethically made, but the 3 Ks overhear and start bartering for the spare t-shirt.

programme.title: Wolfblood S01 E10
programme.desc: Maddy, Rhydian, Tom and Shannon are playing in the woods when Tom notices someone spying on them. Maddy and Rhydian catch their scent - the wild wolfblood is back... Bernie, who owns the local village shop, fills them in about a homeless women who has been sleeping rough in the woods.

programme.title: Wolfblood S01 E11
programme.desc: Rhydian is dabbling with his Eolas powers in school, showing off to his school mates. Maddy can't understand how he is doing it, the tricks go beyond Wolfblood senses and speed. Rhydian shares his secret with Maddy. It's something his mum taught him, Eolas, which wild wolfbloods use to connect themselves with nature.

programme.title: Wolfblood S01 E12
programme.desc: It is the day of the full moon and Maddy and Rhydian aren't looking forward to a night in the den. Rhydian tries to talk Maddy into escaping, but Maddy knows she can't - her parents would be furious! Shannon has been trying to forget about the beast by throwing herself into other interests.

programme.title: Wolfblood S01 E13
programme.desc: Shannon is worried about the wolves and their safety now people know they exist, they may be hunted. She plans to inform the Department of the Environment so they can protect the wolves, but first needs proof that the wolves exist and she knows how to get it - Carl's wolfbait! Maddy and Rhydian are worried, they have to get the bait before Shannon gets her hands on it.

programme.title: Wolfblood S02 E01
programme.desc: Rhydian unexpectedly returns on the night of the full moon, chased by wild wolfbloods as Tom discovers Shannon spying on the Smiths with a surveillance camera hidden in the Den. Maddy's overjoyed to have Rhydian back and persuades her parents to help him re-adjust back to life in Stoneybridge.

programme.title: Wolfblood S02 E02
programme.desc: Maddy finds a strange girl stealing her school clothes from the washing line. The thief turns on Maddy. It's a wolfblood! Maddy gives chase but Rhydian stops her, recognising the girl as Jana, daughter of Alric. Maddy is shocked to see Jana arrive at school the next day with her uniform on, greeting Rhydian like a long lost “friend”.

Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Wild Dolphins
programme.desc: In the waters surrounding New Zealand live a number of dolphin species - each of which has evolved unique strategies in their family pods to survive and thrive in the different habitats around these islands in the Pacific Ocean. On the east coast of the south island off the iconic Kaikoura peninsula, an underwater canyon pushes water seething with nutrients to the surface which provides a year round banquet for huge pods of dusky dolphins. These athletic and highly social dolphins spend their nights feeding out in the canyon, and in early morning they return closer to shore where they rest socialize and play. One of their favourite activities is the “seaweed game” where individuals pass pieces of seaweed to each other practicing fancy maneuvers where they'll catch it on their tail, dorsal or pectoral fins. Down in the south west corner of New Zealand in the majestic landscape of Fiordland live the southern-most bottlenose dolphins. At almost 4 metres long these dolphins have adapted physically to the extreme winter conditions down here by growing bigger and fatter with extra insulating blubber and evolving stubbier beaks and shorter fins and tail flukes to reduce heat loss through their extremities. These fiords are different to the coastal environment in that freshwater sits on top of the denser seawater in a distinct layer, and is much colder than the saltwater and can prove lethal to the pods' calves in winter, so every year the bottlenose dolphins make a short migration to the outer fiords where there is less freshwater to enable their calves to survive. Off New Zealand's north island, in the middle of the Bay of Plenty, the country's most active volcano erupts from the sea, sending plumes of toxic gases rising skywards. In the water surrounding this volcano roam common dolphins - the nomads of the dolphin world. They are pelagic predators which mean they roam the open ocean searching for prey.

To explore the world of the eagle we follow one individual from hatching to leaving the nest and setting up a home. Her fight for survival reveals what it takes to become a queen of the sky.

programme.title: Street of Gongs
programme.desc: In Thailand's rural northeast you will find the street of Gongs. Outside the provincial capital of Ubon Ratchatani in Thailand's rural northeast, a country road nearly thirty kilometers long stretches to the banks of the Mekong River. Even from a distance, you can hear what is being made there: gongs of all sizes in nearly 50 manufactories. The gong is considered the ancient instrument and symbol of Asia. It occupies an important cultural significance, initiates rituals, expels demons, gives strength and courage. This film visits the creators of these unique instruments - a family business that has been laboriously handcrafting gongs for generations. They have a big mission: The abbot of the temple has ordered a new, large gong for the upcoming festival. Will they be able to finish it in time?

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry and Orange are dangling their legs in the stream when something tickles Orange's foot. She is sent squealing from the water, certain an eel is after her. programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: At the next Storytime, Strawberry is going to read a new poem. It's a simple, sweet rhyme about the magic of making wishes on falling stars. She tries a few different rhymes as she goes, noting them on her paper. She is startled to hear applause from Mr. Longface Caterpillar who has heard her recital.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: From the BerryWorks to Strawberry's Café, everyone is excited about who will win this year's Spring Flower Festival! programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's a busy day at Lemon's salon, a charming place that is more than just a hair salon it's one of favorite places for Strawberry and her friends to relax and socialize. They're spirited and laughing and chatting and having a great time, as Lemon runs from one of her friends to the next, doing hair and nails, serving tea and cookies.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry ordered some Zippy Gro daisy seeds and planted them in her garden. She is surprised that they've sprouted in less than a day despite their descriptive moniker. Strawberry comes by to admire them and Blueberry is reminded that the new cookbook Strawberry ordered has arrived. Strawberry is excited to try out the new corn muffin recipe, as its level of difficulty will be a challenge for her. Strawberry follows the muffin recipe, mixes the ingredients, and double checks it.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Berry Best You Can Bee
programme.desc: Strawberry is at Orange's store to mail a birthday card to a friend in Big Bitty City. Just after she drops the card into the mail slot, an ill postal carrier bee sneezes sending envelopes and post cards flying in all directions. The two girls help Jadeybug, a postal clerk, and Postmaster Bee gather up the strewn letters and the ill bee gets sent home from work.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While rehearsing a song alone in her cafe, Strawberry is interrupted by the arrival of Jadeybug. The poor ladybug is stressed out because her twin cousins, Kadiebug and Sadiebug, left her a message that they are coming to visit for a whole week. Jadey is unable to host them because she's having her guest room repainted.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Plum decides to hold a dance recital at Strawberry's Café Cabaret stage and sends out a stack of invitations. Strawberry tells Plum she cannot hold the recital in the Café on her chosen day because the Café is booked.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: All of Berry Bitty City is gathered around to watch the last snowberrykin melt. As the last bit of snow forms a puddle, a cheer goes up, spring is here! It's now time for the annual BerryFest. But with Princess Berrykin out of town on business, who will be the BerryFest Princess and preside over the festival?! Everyone is abuzz with how to go about choosing the Princess and what her duties will be. Postmaster Bee declares the only fair way to go about it is to hold an election. Everyone agrees.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry opens her front door to a throng of Berrykins all cheering for the new BerryFest Princess. She is appreciative of their admiration but unsure of exactly what her duties entail. In response the Berrykins bombard her with her duties - major to miniscule. One Berrykin sums it up by telling her she's responsible for presiding over all the activities of the BerryFest to make it the best.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: Nothing To Fear But Berries Themselves

She determines she doesn't want anything scary around her, just relaxation. But while the girls are having a hair-styling party at Lemon's salon, a malfunction at the BerryWorks causes the whole town to go dark. And Orange begins to get really anxious.

programme.title: Prophecy Of The Green Ninja, Greatest Battles
programme.desc: So the final puzzle forces ninja to question the true meaning of the Green Ninja Prophecy. Solving the puzzles releases a new peril for the Ninja to face. Will memories of their greatest victories be enough to defeat it?

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Sings of Love
programme.desc: See how Stephanie and Olivia enter the Under the Sea photo competition. Jacob wrote a love song! Olivia and her friends are very excited to hear. Tanya and Stephanie are teamed up in baking class. Watch the video for more fun.

programme.title: Video Wonder
programme.desc: Olivia and Andrea visited science camp with Mrs Stevens. On the other hand, Andrea and Mia decides to return a lost skunk to nature. Andrea was reading intimate postcards between Chef Pierre and Mrs. Stevens.

programme.title: Stiix and Stones
programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword.Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely. The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Re-experience the phenomenon that shocked and divided the world, and influenced an entire genre and generation of film-makers, with Camille Keaton's portrayal of young writer Jennifer Hills, her horrific plans for revenge, and some of the most gruesomely, unforgettable scenes ever captured to film.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is sogumm famous for her unique voice and heartfelt music! This artist made herself known to the public through one TV competition show in 2019. Thanks to her wide musical spectrum and outstanding producing skills she won the competition and soon joined the record label AOMG. Of course she continued to pleasantly surprised listeners under the label. Her first album Sobrightttttttt earned both critical and commercial success and that success led her to win the coveted Rookie Prize at the 17th Korean Music Awards. She has also collaborated with a numner of A-list artists including ZICO Oh Hyuk 10CM DJ Wegun and Hoody and her ever-evolving artistry definitely makes us anticipate her future as a musician. In October this year sogumm released her full-length album Precious securing her unique spot in the industry. In this episode sogumm performs Insecurity Prescription Precious and more to show off the essence of her artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented musician!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is risking city-pop songwriter nokdu! nokdu made his big debut in 2018 with the single Say My Name. As a graduate of The Liverpool Institute for Performing Arts founded by Paul McCartney and Mark Featherstone-Witty he covers a wide range of genres in his music ranging from Brit-pop to punk to R&B. Backed up by his academic background he boasts his outstanding ability not only as a songwriter but also a lyricist producer and singer. Also known for his stage manners he is quickly capturing the ears and souls of countless listeners. Currently he's taking part in the competition program Super Band 2. His fantastic performance in the show definitely makes us anticipate his future as a musician. In this episode nokdu performs Stay With Me Wona and more to show off the essence of his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the sensual pop-duo WeAreYoung! Composed of keyboardist and vocalist KIM Kyung-min and guitarist and vocalist GU Ki-hoon this duo made themselves known to the public with their heartfelt songs about youth and love. Thanks to their outstanding musicality they won the 2017 Shinhan Card Rookie Award the Silver Prize at the 2017 Martin Contest and Best Rookie at the Beautiful Mint Life 2018. This year they were chosen as recipients of the MUSE ON 2021 which aims to connect musicians and fans during the COVID-19 pandemic. Earlier this year WeAreYoung announced their much-anticipated comeback after completing their mandatory military duties and they are bound to impress once again with their songs A Day Full Of You Let's not do that Only I Love You and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these two talented musicians!

programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Stories By Rabindranath Tagore
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Maata Ki Mahima
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Hamare
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Indipedia

programme.title: The new Porsche 911 GT3 R
programme.desc: The turbocharged three-litre flat-six in the new 911 GTS delivers 353 kW (480 PS). Maximum torque is 570 Nm, an increase of 20 Nm over its predecessor. Zero to 100 km/h takes just 3.3 seconds (911 Carrera 4 GTS: Fuel consumption combined (NEDC) 10.5 – 9.7 l/100 km, Fuel consumption combined (WLTP) 11.4 – 10.6 l/100 km, CO₂ emissions combined (NEDC) 240 – 222 g/km, CO₂ emissions combined (WLTP) 259 – 240 g/km) in the 911 Carrera 4 GTS Coupé with the eight-speed Porsche dual-clutch transmission (PDK): three tenths faster than its predecessor. A seven-speed manual transmission with a particularly short throw is available for all 911 GTS models as an alternative to the PDK.

programme.title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID. Buzz
programme.sub-title: How was the electric Microbus created
programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. With new software, new assistance functions are also making their way into the ID. family. Available as an option is ‘Travel Assist with swarm data', which facilitates partially automated driving across the entire speed range and, for the first time, assisted lane-changing on the motorway. Also new: the ‘Memory Function' for automated parking on a previously saved route.

programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.desc: The sixth generation Opel/Vauxhall Astra and third generation Peugeot 308 are both based on the Stellantis EMP2 platform and, unsurprisingly, score very similarly across all four areas of assessment. Both the offset test and the full-width crash test highlighted marginal chest injury protection for average male and small female drivers, and neither car was equipped with a centre airbag for far-side crash protection, a countermeasure which is increasingly common on modern cars. Both cars offer plenty of crash avoidance technology but do not include some of the latest advancements introduced in the market. The cars' four-star ratings apply also to their PHEV variants.

programme.title: C'era una volta un matrimonio
programme.desc: Una settimana prima del suo matrimonio la figlia di un dittatore dei Caraibi ferisce un uomo in un incidente stradale. Mentre lo aiuta a rimettersi in salute, inizia a dubitare del corso che sta prendendo la sua vita capendo che il vero amore non conosce distinzioni sociali. Riuscirà ad ottenere l'approvazione del padre?

programme.title: Un matrimonio sotto l'albero
programme.desc: Due genitori single con figlie piccole si avvicinano mentre collaborano ai rispettivi progetti: Cadence con il matrimonio e Henry con la sua cliente di alto profilo, la signora Sutton, e la sua festa VIP annuale della vigilia di Natale.

programme.title: Un matrimonio da ricordare
programme.desc: In contrapposizione per via di un progetto di sviluppo, Olivia e Brian sono sorpresi dallo scoprire di essere la damigella d'onore e il testimone dello stesso matrimonio. Dovranno mettere da parte i loro dissapori per salvare le nozze dei loro migliori amici, scoprendo di avere in comune molto più di quanto credevano.

programme.title: Innamorarsi a Sunset Terrace
programme.desc: Esausta dal suo lavoro di marketing, Sophie affitta un Airbnb da un padre vedovo e sua figlia per rilassarsi. Tuttavia, la figlia è decisa a far innamorare ancora una volta suo padre, con gli occhi puntati su Sophie.

programme.title: Innamorarsi a San Antonio
programme.desc: Adela Romero è una chef di successo che lavora in televisione, a Los Angeles. Quando ha un'offerta per andare a lavorare in giro per l'Europa, tentenna per non sballottare troppo la figlia, a cui in effetti la loro città natale, San Antonio, manca a tal punto da scappare, un giorno, per tornarci da sola. Adela la segue e finisce per conoscere e fraternizzare con un giornalista che aveva recensito male il suo programma: a quel punto sarà ancora più in dubbio se rimanere a San Antonio o accettare l'offerta europea.

programme.title: Vikings: L'invasione dei franchi
programme.desc: e i Danesi, mentre a sud si sono stanziati i Franchi.Nel 700 dopo Cristo, l'Europa settentrionale è divisa in due differenti parti: a nord dei fiumi si sono stabiliti i Frisoni, i Sassoni

programme.title: Sotto Il Cielo Delle Hawaii
programme.desc: Un famoso militare professionista ritorna sul luogo dei suoi più grandi trionfi legati al programma spaziale degli Stati Uniti a Honolulu, Hawaii. Qui incontra una sua ex, ma altrettanto inaspettatamente si innamora della giovane pilota dell'Air Force a lui assegnata.

programme.title: La coppia dei campioni
programme.desc: Due dipendenti della stessa multinazionale vincono alla lotteria aziendale un paio di biglietti per la finale della Champions League. Uno milanese, l'altro romano, uno benestante e l'altro nullatenente si conoscono per la prima volta all'imbarco per Praga detestandosi a prima vista.

programme.title: Pushing Tin
programme.desc: Nick Falzone è il numero uno dei controllori del traffico aereo, finché un tranquillo sconosciuto, Russell Bell, non viene trasferito nel dipartimento. La rivalità tra i due migliori controllori del traffico aereo del TRACON di New York sale a un livello potenzialmente pericoloso.

programme.title: Ploi
programme.desc: Ploi è un pulcino di piviere che ha paura a spiccare il volo.

programme.title: Birba
programme.desc: Un gatto di nome Oscar vive da tempo in un grattacielo in città con suo figlio Birba. Un giorno, incuriosito dal mondo esterno, Birba decide di uscire di casa ed avventurarsi alla ricerca di Miciolandia.

programme.title: Where's Chicky?
programme.desc: S1:E1 Episodio 1 - Nessuno sa dove sia Chicky. Sappiamo solo che è carino e tanto ingenuo. In questa serie, seguite Chicky, l'uccellino dei cartoni animati, mentre si aggira intorno a un frigorifero, un tostapane, un copertone e tanti altri oggetti!

programme.title: Where's Chicky?
programme.desc: S1:E2 Episodio 2 - Nessuno sa dove sia Chicky. Sappiamo solo che è carino e tanto ingenuo. In questa serie, seguite Chicky, l'uccellino dei cartoni animati, mentre si aggira intorno a un puzzle, un trenino, un cestino e tanti altri oggetti!

programme.title: Where's Chicky?
programme.desc: S1:E3 Episodio 3 - Nessuno sa dove sia Chicky. Sappiamo solo che è carino e tanto ingenuo. In questa serie, seguite Chicky, l'uccellino dei cartoni animati, mentre si aggira intorno a una lampadina, una piastra, un Forza 4 e altri oggetti!

programme.title: Where's Chicky?
programme.desc: S2:E1 Episodio 1 - Chicky e Bekky suonano uno strumento a corde. Situazioni esilaranti e sorprese inaspettate per i nostri tre piccoli amici in questa compilation!

programme.title: Where's Chicky?
programme.desc: S2:E2 Episodio 2 - Chicky e Poyo saltano più e più volte da un divertente trampolino rosa. Situazioni esilaranti e sorprese inaspettate per i nostri tre piccoli amici in questa compilation!

programme.title: Where's Chicky?
programme.desc: S2:E3 Episodio 3 - Chicky e Bekky scoprono un oggetto divertente con dei quadrati illuminati. Situazioni esilaranti e sorprese inaspettate per i nostri tre piccoli amici in questa compilation!

programme.title: Care Bears: Unlock the Magic
programme.desc: S2:E4 Il mistero dello spettro - Quando Burbero pensa che il suo nascondiglio sia infestato, chiede aiuto agli orsetti. Gli orsetti non credono ai fantasmi… finché non si ritrovano faccia a faccia con uno! Solo quando Condivisione affronta le sue paure riescono a venire a capo di questa inquietante situazione!

programme.title: Care Bears: Unlock the Magic
programme.desc: S2:E5 I cattivi colpiscono ancora! - Gli Orsetti del Cuore decollano nello spazio dopo che un UFO gigante inizia a rubare tutta la cura proveniente dalla Terra. È la prima avventura galattica degli orsetti mentre respingono alieni sciocchi e cercano di salvare Tantamore prima che scompaia per sempre!

programme.title: Care Bears: Unlock the Magic
programme.sub-title: S2:E6 Senza Cuore e gli Orsetti
programme.desc: S2:E6 Senza Cuore e gli Orsetti - Che i giochi abbiano inizio! Un malvagio mago di nome Senza Cuore mette gli Orsetti del Cuore contro la Banda dei Cattivi in una serie di giochi contorti. L'unica speranza degli orsetti è usare il potere della cura per battere Senza Cuore al suo stesso gioco!

programme.title: Big Baby
programme.desc: Uno scienziato progetta una macchina per la trasformazione genetica e il suo nipotino di soli 4 anni si trasforma accidentalmente in un uomo di 30. Il "Bambino" sfugge e corre intorno alla città rincorso dai fratelli che fanno di tutto per recuperarlo prima dell'arrivo dei propri genitori.

programme.title: L'oro di Roma
programme.desc: Roma, Seconda guerra mondiale. Durante l'occupazione nazista, il maggiore Kappler ordina agli ebrei di consegnare cinquanta chilogrammi d'oro in cambio della salvezza di duecento ostaggi. Da una storia vera, ispirata al rastrellamento del ghetto di Roma.

programme.title: All'armi, siam fascisti!
programme.desc: Mezzo secolo di storia, dal Cinquantenario al Centenario dell'Unità d'Italia, ricostruito con documenti di repertorio: dalla guerra di Libia alla pace di Versailles, dai tumulti del dopoguerra al terrore e alla corruzione fascista, dalla Resistenza ai fatti del luglio '60. Il film propone a conclusione questa domanda: il fascismo è veramente finito?

programme.title: Hot Corn Cine News
programme.desc: Hot Corn Cine News è un appuntamento bisettimanale, nato dall'unione tra LoveTv Channel e The Hot Corn, che racconta tutte le novità del mondo del cinema, tra ospiti, eventi e interviste, prossime uscite in sala e cronache mondane. Ad introdurci in questo mondo di news sulla Settima Arte, Irene Cortese e Sara Scarsella.

programme.title: Il sorriso della iena
programme.desc: Dopo la morte della madre in circostanze ambigue, un'adolescente inizia a sospettare che il suo patrigno, rimasto vedovo da poco, possa essere coinvolto.

programme.title: Peccatori di provincia
programme.desc: "Parenti serpenti, cugini assassini e fratelli coltelli" in questa simpaticissima commedia con Renzo Montagnani! Il ricco Emanuele Lo Curcio, alla sua morte, lascia tutti i suoi beni alla figlia naturale Domitilla. Delusione e rabbia da parte dei suoi numerosi parenti, indebitati fino al collo, i quali, ospitata la ragazza, tentano con ogni sorta di raggiri di spogliarla dell'eredità.

programme.title: Guardia, ladro e cameriera
programme.desc: Spassoso film comico con Nino Manfredi, Mario Carotenuto e Luciano Salce. La notte di San Silvestro, un giovane squattrinato si lascia coinvolgere dagli amici a tentare un colpo in un lussuoso appartamento, che sarebbe dovuto essere vuoto. A complicare la situazione ci penseranno una guardia notturna e una cameriera che rischieranno di finire nei guai.

programme.title: Domenica d'agosto
programme.desc: Grande classico con Marcello Mastroianni. Dalla calda città di Roma una folla variegata, di ogni estrazione sociale, si muove con mezzi diversi verso il lido di Ostia. C'è chi va al mare in bicicletta, chi, con la propria auto, ci porta tutta la famiglia, chi finge di essere ricco per conquistare l'amore dei suoi sogni e così via. È l'Italia del 7 agosto 1949, festa di San Gaetano.

programme.title: Genitori in blue jeans
programme.desc: Una serie di personaggi della Roma bene degli anni '50 frequenta la rinomata sartoria di Peppino, un uomo che ha respinto tutte le proposte di matrimonio che gli sono state fatte negli anni. Durante un viaggio a Parigi, Peppino conosce una donna e finalmente se ne innamora, ma proprio dopo aver deciso di sposarla viene a scoprire qualcosa di inaspettato.

programme.title: Il Magnifico Cornuto
programme.desc: Meravigliosa commedia con Claudia Cardinale, Ugo Tognazzi e Gian Maria Volontè. Andrea Artusi è geloso e sospettoso a tal punto che sua moglie Maria Grazia deve inventarsi il nome di un finto amante. In questo modo il marito si sente soddisfatto ma la donna comincia ad abituarsi all'idea di averne uno. Un grande classico del cinema italiano.

programme.title: I Due Orfanelli
programme.desc: Una spassosa commedia con il celebre Totò. Gaspare e Battista vivono in un collegio di Parigi che accoglie i "figli di nessuno". Quando Il primo scopre di essere il discendente di una nobile e ricca famiglia, parte per cercare i suoi genitori. Quando li trova, si imbatte in una spiacevole sorpresa. Un film di Mario Mattoli

programme.title: Ciao maschio
programme.desc: Il rifiuto della paternità e la scelta di adottare come figlio una scimmietta saranno per il protagonista, Lafayette , l'ultima e delirante affermazione di individualità.

programme.title: Giorni d'amore
programme.desc: Due giovani paesani, Angela e Pasquale, dovrebbero sposarsi, ma non hanno i mezzi per affrontare le spese delle nozze. La soluzione suggerita dai genitori è: se Pasquale rapisse Angela, la ragazza sarebbe compromessa e s`imporrebbe il classico matrimonio riparatore, al quale non si addice nesusna fastosa cerimonia...

programme.title: Il corsaro nero
programme.desc: Il capitano Black un pirata coraggioso e affascinante, alla guida della sua ciurma decide di assaltare la nave che porta l`oro dalle colonie spagnole alla madrepatria. Quando scopre che la nave non trasporta oro, ma la moglie del viceré della colonia, Black decide di rapirla per chiedere l`oro in riscatto. Anche Skull vuole l`oro, si allea così con altri pirati nemici di Black per sottrargli la donna..

programme.title: Cronaca di un amore
programme.desc: Enrico, vittima di una immotivata gelosia nei confronti del passato sentimentale della moglie Paola, assolda un investigatore per capire se gli fedele. Questo atteggiamento spinge Paola tra le braccia di Guido, uomo di cui era innamorata in passato. Inevitabilmente, tra i due scoppia una pericolosa e travolgente passione...

programme.title: Dopo l'amore
programme.desc: Marie e Boris, dopo quindici anni di matrimonio, vivono separati in casa a causa di difficoltà economiche e per il bene delle figlie. Questo dramma contemporaneo esplora i paradossi e le sfide di una relazione che si sgretola lentamente.

programme.title: XX secolo
programme.desc: Un fiammante impresario di Broadway che è caduto in difficoltà cerca di convincere la sua ex amante, ora una diva di Hollywood, a tornare e far risorgere la sua carriera fallimentare.

programme.title: I diari della motocicletta
programme.desc: Nel 1952, Ernesto Guevara e Alberto Granado attraversano l'America Latina in motocicletta. Il viaggio, nato come avventura, diventa una scoperta delle ingiustizie sociali che cambierà per sempre il loro destino. Uno di loro diventerà il leggendario Che.

programme.title: Il lamento sul sentiero
programme.desc: Il piccolo Apu è testimone della triste condizione della propria decaduta famiglia bengalese, di casta bramina, ai primi del Novecento. La sorella maggiore Durga muore mentre un violento monsone investe il villaggio. Il padre, dopo aver perso il lavoro, decide di trasferirsi con la famiglia a Benares.

programme.title: Un pizzico di magia
programme.desc: Matt, figlio di un'importante famiglia di streghe, è atteso dal Consiglio delle Streghe per sposare la sua migliore amica Lizzy. Ma quando Matt incontra Sara, una psichiatra, la sua magia lo abbandona e Sara scopre di aver improvvisamente acquisito dei poteri magici.

programme.title: BASTA DIRE Sì
programme.desc: La vita di Michelle è in declino: è stata licenziata e mollata lo stesso giorno. La sua migliore amica Sara, la convince a partecipare a un ritiro benessere dove deve solo "dire di sì" . Lì, però, col suo mentore Josh nasce una chimica inaspettata…

programme.title: THE ROMANTICS
programme.desc: Sette trentenni, compagni al college, si riuniscono dopo 6 anni per il matrimonio di Tom e Lila. La notte prima del matrimonio, Laura, damigella d'onore di Lila ed ex fiamma di Tom, e il promesso sposo scoprono di essere ancora innamorati.

programme.title: BUGIE E EX MOGLI: I SEGRETI DI MAPLE STREET
programme.desc: Quando Katie ha iniziato a frequentare il suo vicino divorziato, si aspettava il solito gossip di Maple Street. Ma quando l'ex moglie del suo fidanzato viene trovata morta, si rende conto di trovarsi di fronte a una minaccia molto più pericolosa dei pettegolezzi.

programme.title: 2012: Supernova
programme.desc: In una galassia non lontana dalla Terra una stella si sta trasformando in Supernova. Mentre le microonde emesse dal gigante stellare minacciano il Pianeta, uno scienziato escogita un disperato piano di salvezza. C'è ancora una speranza per l'umanità.

programme.title: La banda degli onesti
programme.desc: Tre uomini perbene ma goffi che affrontano difficoltà economiche iniziano con riluttanza a fabbricare banconote false. Il figlio di uno di loro è il poliziotto che segue il caso, ignorando il coinvolgimento del padre.

programme.title: Serving Sara IT
programme.desc: Dopo essere stata notificata della richiesta di divorzio, una donna convince un ufficiale giudiziario ad aiutarla a riottenere ciò che le è dovuto.

programme.title: True women IT
programme.desc: Nel west dei mitici anni della frontiera Georgia Lawshe Woods si oppone alle strette regole morali per affermare sé stessa. Si appassiona alla politica affronta i pericoli della guerra e combatte l'ostilità degli indiani.

programme.title: Equals
programme.desc: In un mondo futuro privo di avidità, povertà, violenza e sentimenti, una nuova malattia minaccia di risvegliare emozioni sopite in chi ne viene colpito, prima di essere allontanato dalla società e mai più rivisto. In tale contesto, Nia e Silas vivranno una relazione proibita.

programme.title: Equals
programme.desc: In un mondo futuro privo di avidità, povertà, violenza e sentimenti, una nuova malattia minaccia di risvegliare emozioni sopite in chi ne viene colpito, prima di essere allontanato dalla società e mai più rivisto. In tale contesto, Nia e Silas vivranno una relazione proibita.
